prompt:

Header text verbatim: "blandad". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "mixed".
Scene: A mixed salad with clearly distinct lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber and peppers tossed together in one bowl.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "blanda = mix; blandad = mixed.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Vi beställde en blandad sallad.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
